Create basic Atlas inbound order.description:
An example with an almost minimal set of information

Due and Terminal are not specified, since HU's are released by the conveyor, ops can only react.
handlingUnitId is an SSCC code
Barcode will be the same as the handling unit id, and can be omitted.
OrderId and OrderLineId could also be omitted, but can be used to reference WMS entities like SAP shipment and TransferOrder ids
Quality is a customer defined string, only tracked in ops and used as a search criterium when outbounding.

Outbound order with OrderDemands.description:
Create an outbound order using OrderDemands instead of OrderLines. 
OrderDemands define the stock requirements, and the system will automatically resolve these into OrderLines based on available stock.

This example shows requesting different stock items with specific quantities, and the system will find and allocate the appropriate handling units.

Simple outbound order with single OrderD.description:
Basic example of using a single OrderDemand for outbound fulfillment.
The system will automatically find and allocate stock matching the StockId and requested quantity.
